findings.issue: On the writer-session route the med finding unavailable_skill_finding raises is a validation candidate like any code finding (sort_findings: a finding with no held verdict is a candidate), and VALIDATE_RULE offers only the kinds correctness / requirement / other. A finding that says the review skill did not load is honestly `other`, or a withdrawal after reading the plan, and either one makes it a note (sort_findings 'confirmed it as other, which does not block'). The triage then lists it under `noted` instead of the open findings a triage answer settles. So the 'so a human decides' that the brief section, the docstring and phase-signoff.md promise holds as a shown note, not as an open decision. It is not silently passed: verdict 'findings' keeps advance_applies from auto-signing, so a triage decision is still printed.
findings.resolution: Mark the raised finding as process-sourced (for example a `source` field set by unavailable_skill_finding) and have sort_findings put it straight into `unowned` (the human stop) without a validation verdict. Or, if notes are acceptable, say in the docstring and in the brief section that the validation pass may record it as a note.
